analysis: Documentation-only changes in docs/provider/cli-reference.md: head line 3 updates the date; head line 564 adds the benchmark flags `--runtime-concurrency <sizes>` and `--runtime-stagger` (RuntimeConcurrencyBenchmark) and states the prefix cache is off for runtime generation. The range map also lists head lines 1208-1209, which fall outside the supplied units and were not examined. Benchmark harness flags are local operator tooling. They do not touch the coordinator WebSocket (TB-002), attestation or authorization (TB-009/TB-011), tokens (A-008) or prompt plaintext (A-001). The "prefix cache off" statement is consistent with the T-041 posture; whether the RuntimeConcurrencyBenchmark source actually disables the SSD cache was not supplied. The rest of the visible text (logout and revocation at lines 520-542, the cache command, and the GLM prefix-cache default at lines 41-42) is unchanged context and was not treated as new. No security regression identified. Remaining question for integration: confirm that RuntimeConcurrencyBenchmark.swift constructs engines with the prefix cache disabled, as documented, and examine head lines 1208-1209.
